1: // Simple side‑scrolling Space Junk Collector game
2: // Canvas with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
10: 
11:   // Game objects
12:   const ship = { x: 80, y: H / 2, w: 30, h: 15, vy: 0, shield: 3 };
13:   const debris = [];
14:   const asteroids = [];
15:   let score = 0;
16:   const targetScore = 20;
17:   let gameOver = false;
18: 
19:   // Input
20:   const keys = {};
21:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
22:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
23: 
24:   function spawn() {
25:     // debris: small blue circles
26:     if (Math.random() < 0.04) {
27:       debris.push({ x: W, y: Math.random() * H, r: 6, vx: -2 });
28:     }
29:     // asteroids: larger red circles
30:     if (Math.random() < 0.01) {
31:       asteroids.push({ x: W, y: Math.random() * H, r: 14, vx: -3 });
32:     }
33:   }
34: 
35:   function update() {
36:     if (gameOver) return;
37:     // ship control – vertical only (ArrowUp/Down or W/S)
38:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW']) ship.vy = -3;
39:     else if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['KeyS']) ship.vy = 3;
40:     else ship.vy = 0;
41:     ship.y += ship.vy;
42:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - ship.h, ship.y));
43: 
44:     // move objects
45:     debris.forEach(d => d.x += d.vx);
46:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.x += a.vx);
47: 
48:     // remove off‑screen
49:     while (debris.length && debris[0].x < -20) debris.shift();
50:     while (asteroids.length && asteroids[0].x < -20) asteroids.shift();
51: 
52:     // collisions
53:     debris.forEach((d, i) => {
54:       if (d.x < ship.x + ship.w && d.x > ship.x &&
55:           d.y > ship.y && d.y < ship.y + ship.h) {
56:         score++;
57:         debris.splice(i, 1);
58:       }
59:     });
60:     asteroids.forEach((a, i) => {
61:       const dx = a.x - (ship.x + ship.w / 2);
62:       const dy = a.y - (ship.y + ship.h / 2);
63:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
64:       if (dist < a.r + Math.max(ship.w, ship.h) / 2) {
65:         ship.shield--;
66:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
67:         if (ship.shield <= 0) gameOver = true;
68:       }
69:     });
70: 
71:     if (score >= targetScore) gameOver = true;
72:     spawn();
73:   }
74: 
75:   function draw() {
76:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
77:     // ship
78:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
79:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
80:     // shield indicator
81:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
82:     for (let i = 0; i < ship.shield; i++) {
83:       ctx.fillRect(10 + i * 12, 10, 10, 5);
84:     }
85:     // debris
86:     ctx.fillStyle = '#88f';
87:     debris.forEach(d => {
88:       ctx.beginPath();
89:       ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
90:       ctx.fill();
91:     });
92:     // asteroids
93:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
94:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
95:       ctx.beginPath();
96:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
97:       ctx.fill();
98:     });
99:     // score
100:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
101:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
102:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W - 100, 20);
103:     // game over / win
104:     if (gameOver) {
105:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
106:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
107:       const msg = score >= targetScore ? 'You Win!' : 'Game Over';
108:       ctx.fillText(msg, W / 2 - 50, H / 2);
109:     }
110:   }
111: 
112:   function loop() {
113:     update();
114:     draw();
115:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
116:   }
117: 
118:   loop();
119: });
